query_analysis.original_query: Our liquid-liquid extractor shows oscillations in flow rates between stages. Could this be related to pump controls or system instability?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate the root causes of flow rate oscillations in a liquid-liquid extraction system, focusing on potential pump control issues and system dynamic instabilities

selected_agents.role: Analyze system dynamics and potential control system failures
Diagnose potential root causes of flow rate oscillations
Evaluate extraction system performance and potential design impacts

communication_strategy.information_flow: Systematic investigation of flow rate oscillation mechanisms
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative problem decomposition and cross-domain analysis

clarification_questions: What is the frequency and amplitude of the observed flow rate oscillations?
Have there been any recent changes in pump equipment or control systems?
Can you provide details about the liquid-liquid extractor's design and operating conditions?
Are the oscillations consistent across all stages or specific to certain sections?
